QuantLabExactDecimal.description: Canonical finite Decimal38 after arithmetic, without output quantization: no exponent, plus sign, negative zero or trailing fractional zero. At most38 significant digits checked semantically. Selection never compares twelve-place display values.

QuantLabDisplayDecimal.description: Display only: twelve fractional digits, ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

QuantLabStrategySelectionPolicy.description: Exactly five fields. Explicit null minima disable gates; maxDrawdown has no hidden default. Immutable hash binding includes every parameter/null. Inclusive exact comparisons. Drawdown-first explicitly prefers capital preservation including flat. Distinct from data-selection policy.

QuantLabSearchSpace.description: At most3 parameters/32 explicit values each; no ranges, code, imports or URLs. Saturating product count rejects total>32 before materialization. Canonically duplicate values/candidates and any invalid combination reject the whole grid before jobs.

QuantLabInterval.description: Positive half-open UTC [start,end) at valid15-minute calendar boundaries; checked semantically.

QuantLabProtocol.description: Positive disjoint non-expanding phases: trainEnd<=validationStart, validationEnd<=testStart, testEnd_i<=trainingStart_i+1, final testEnd<=holdoutStart. Span with seed<=366days. All fold/final decisions atomically freeze before any OOS. Every phase resets cash/FLAT/state. In-sample descriptive; validation optimization, not independent validation.

QuantLabPhaseBinding.description: Shared W=max(slow-1,RSI period,0) completed calendar bars immediately before each phase. Holdout alone fold=null. Warm-up initializes features without fills or fitted coefficients.

QuantLabExperimentCreateRequest.description: Immutable redacted draft version, no executable content/URLs. POST creates revision, never mutates. Entire Cartesian grid valid/unique total1..32 plus two fixed references. Domain checks mapping/chronology/canonical decimals and mode/data-policy agreement. Strict default; retrospective explicit without fallback.

QuantLabCandidateCounts.description: Search only, retries count once; references separate. Complete/failed/blocked/notEvaluated disjoint terminal counts, started includes attempted.

QuantLabCursor.description: Opaque authenticated cursor bound to session, operation, resource/immutable report or definition hash, snapshot, filters, phase/fold and order. Foreign/tampered/expired=>400 CURSOR_INVALID. Never infer offsets or tokens.

QuantLabExposureOverlap.description: Every historical performance role including legacy/failed/blocked/superseded, independent of hypothesis, actor, revision or mode. At least one prior batch/run ID. Warm-up overlap separate causal history.

QuantLabResearchHistory.description: Validation current preview; admission atomically binds predecessor register/current round. Drafts not tests, retries once. No overlap never certifies independence/freshness. Later warnings do not change bound hashes.

QuantLabBudgetEstimate.description: Conservative estimate without hypothetical cache: candidates/references, repeated seeds/phases and final test. Missing calendar cannot yield positive admission. Not latency promise.

QuantLabValidation.description: Persisted feasibility without data release. VALIDATED guarantees neither snapshot/PIT eligibility nor admission; start rechecks gates.

QuantLabBatchStartRequest.description: Explicit exact definition version/hash and validation. Idempotency scope actor/operation/definitionVersion; changed payload=>409. Admission atomically checks resources and binds prior research history.

QuantLabManifestReference.description: Immutable existing revision/calendar/trust storage references, no copied finance/bar ledger. Common snapshot/policies/mode/cost/fill/protocol/seed/build/metrics/benchmark. Snapshot binds in RUNNING before simulation.

QuantLabBatch.description: SUCCEEDED needs complete immutable report/reliability, including documented no-selection. Data blockers BLOCKED; technical errors FAILED. No cancel/trading/provider/dispatch. At most3 attempts of295seconds,885 active attempt seconds; publication<=12MiB batch-wide, immutable after terminal state.

QuantLabCandidate.description: SHA256 canonical ID/version/parameters. Fixed references never automatically search members. Failed/blocked remain visible, prohibit complete ranking.

QuantLabActivityMetrics.description: Actual fill/quantity transitions, not targets/trades/roundtrips. endOpenPositionCount0/1; buy+sell=fill; entry-exit=endOpenPositionCount. Phase reset quantity0. Missing fill evidence never becomes empty tuple.

QuantLabExposureMetrics.description: Equal-weight positive-quantity bar closes, not calendar-time exposure. Gross=money(q*close) separately from equity-cash because HALF_EVEN not distributive. Open positions mark-to-market without synthetic exits.

QuantLabActivityWarnings.description: Descriptive exact comparisons: fills0; investedbars0; 0<barRatio<=.01; 0<entries<3; abs(return-flat)<=.0001. Neither hidden gates nor quality scores. No exposure-adjusted extrapolation.

QuantLabSelectionValues.description: Exact canonical Decimal38 selector inputs. Final component medians (lower+upper)/2 without display quantization. Counts stay integers; eligibility always per-fold, never median counts.

QuantLabRankingKey.description: Ascending exact: standard(-netReturn,maxDrawdown,turnover,candidateId); preservation(maxDrawdown,-netReturn,turnover,candidateId). Final components validation medians. IDs lowercase ASCII.

QuantLabCandidateSelectionEvidence.description: Every gate including disabled minima per validation. Final eligibility requires all gates in every validation. No OOS/holdout value in selector input.

QuantLabSelection.description: All decisions atomically frozen before any OOS. SELECTED winner required; complete NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE null/no fallback. INCOMPLETE no winner/full ranking, blocks success. Negative/flat allowed. FINAL fold=null. Bad holdout never reselection.

QuantLabReliabilityReference.description: References getQuantLabReliabilityReport under its owning experiment batch and the Quant Lab result resource. Childrun ID is an immutable execution reference; new QSL strategies/modes are not representable by legacy run/report DTOs. No duplicated result payload. Eligibility describes computability under exploratory research limitations, never PIT evidence or trading permission; evidenceStatus independently describes PIT/data evidence.

QuantLabCandidateResult.description: Only selected candidates run OOS/holdout. NOT_EVALUATED_BY_PROTOCOL=not selected; NOT_EVALUATED_NO_SELECTION=no eligible winner. No evaluation=>null metrics/reliability, never zero. Complete phases of failed batches remain visible without full aggregate.

QuantLabFoldOverview.description: Separate descriptive reset-fold ranges. Never concatenate equity, average Sharpe, sum trades, assert significance. Zero complete candidate OOS=>N/A NO_SELECTED_CANDIDATE. Holdout separate.

QuantLabSensitivityCell.description: Validation only, no interpolation or zero fill. In-sample/OOS never share a selection rank.

QuantLabComparisonReport.description: Immutable server-calculated phase report plus append-only current warnings. Complete no-selection valid; failed candidate prohibits full ranking. Route cursor paginates history overlaps bound to report/original register hash. Performance pages reuse run/reliability references.

QuantLabExperimentComparison.description: Read-only grouped references for max4 batches, no job or cross-batch ranking even for equal bindings. Selection/exposure histories stay separate.

QuantLabEquityPage.description: Phase/fold-specific exact bar-close curve, no concatenation across resets. Future downsampled series needs explicit different sampling metadata.

QuantLabDrawdownPage.description: Phase/fold-specific exact bar-close curve, no concatenation across resets. Future downsampled series needs explicit different sampling metadata.

QuantLabProblem.description: Sanitized bounded error, no input echo/credentials/provider/SQL/stack detail. Data blockers use durable BLOCKED resources.

QuantLabSelectionMedians.description: Componentwise Decimal38 validation medians, without output quantization. Even fold counts use (lower+upper)/2. No invented median entry/session counts: activity/session eligibility is checked as exact integers in every validation fold.

BacktestTimestamp.description: UTC with Z and at most microsecond precision; local offsets and naive values are rejected.

BacktestStartCash.description: Positive USD cash at most 1000000000, at most 8 fractional digits.

BacktestSnapshotReference.description: Immutable complete-commit dataset boundary; later commits remain excluded even when their timestamps are earlier.

BacktestReliabilityFinding.description: Whitelist-only finding, without provider payload/free-text diagnostics. Current revocations/corrections are reported separately from this immutable finding.

QuantLabReliabilityReport.description: QSL-FINAL projection of the existing immutable report store, never an execution permission or quality/profit score. SQL validates exact published batch/run/candidate/role/instrument/mode/snapshot/protocol/phase bindings. Canonical reportHash is SHA256 of {report: metadata excluding reportHash/reportId/batchId/runId, findings: complete ordered findings, revisionReferences: complete ordered references}; the physical store fingerprint separately binds IDs. The hash is injected on read. Strict completeness requires verified availability at every bound decision cutoff and PASS historical-availability evidence. Current warnings are excluded from historical report bytes. overallStatus retains exploratory computability semantics independently of evidenceStatus: complete Strict PIT evidence remains EXPLORATORY_WITH_LIMITATIONS, while BLOCKED or INCOMPLETE evidence is BLOCKED. Strict evidence is not scientific validation or trading authorization.

QuantLabReliabilityReportPage.description: Bounded projection of the same report record; cursor binds batch/report/hash/section/session. Only the selected section is populated. No duplicate result payload or report store.
